settings.description: About downloads, reading the books and using the pictures.

settings.text: If your question is not here, write to us.

settings.question: How do I get the book?
settings.answer: As soon as you pay, the download link is on the order page and in your receipt email. Nothing is posted.

settings.question: What format is it?
settings.answer: A PDF with a fixed layout, so every page looks the way it was designed. Each product page lists the number of pages and the file size.

settings.question: What can I read it on?
settings.answer: Anything that opens a PDF. A tablet or a large screen shows the plates best, and you can zoom right in.

settings.question: The email did not arrive. What now?
settings.answer: Look in your spam folder first. If it is not there, write to us with the email you used at checkout and we will send the link again.

settings.question: Can I print the pages?
settings.answer: Yes, for yourself. The books are made for screens, so a home print will not match a printed art book.

settings.question: Can I share the file?
settings.answer: Please do not. Send friends the link to the book instead. If you teach, write to us about a class licence.
